message.reasoning:
The poster has the browser pane covering nearly all of the terminal, which is only a thin dark strip on the left. The card claims terminal output streams in before the browser slides across, but in this layout the browser hides the terminal. The headline promises "one window, every agent" while the screen shows a single STRIVE app and no agents at all, so the copy and the visual don't match.

I'm weighing whether this poster should be edited or replaced, since the browser covers the terminal and the "every agent" headline isn't backed by anything on screen. I'm leaning toward editing it, because the footer's "Real cmux screen, 8 Nov" still holds up.
